```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(fixest)
library(haven)
library(LSTbook)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(ggdag)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
snse.df <- read.csv("snsemod.csv") 
```

```{r}
snse.df <- snse.df[, -c(2,4)]
snse.df <- snse.df[-c(337:341), ]
```

```{r}
colnames(snse.df)[1] <- "country"
colnames(snse.df)[2] <- "year"
colnames(snse.df)[3] <- "fuel_access"
colnames(snse.df)[4] <- "health_exp_pct"
colnames(snse.df)[5] <- "infant_mortality"
colnames(snse.df)[6] <- "infant_mortality_f"
colnames(snse.df)[7] <- "infant_mortality_m"
colnames(snse.df)[8] <- "health_exp_pcap"
colnames(snse.df)[9] <- "pm2.5"
```

```{r}
snse.df |> point_plot(infant_mortality~pm2.5, annot = "model")
```

```{r}
snse.df$health_exp_pct <- as.numeric(snse.df$health_exp_pct)
```

```{r}
snse.df |> point_plot(infant_mortality~pm2.5 + health_exp_pct, annot = "model")
```

```{r}
# Create vectors for South Asia and Southeast Asia countries
south_asia <- c("Afghanistan", "Pakistan", "Bangladesh", "India", "Nepal", "Bhutan", "Sri Lanka")
southeast_asia <- c("Myanmar", "Philippines", "Thailand", "Vietnam", "Singapore", "Malaysia", "Laos", "Indonesia", "Cambodia")

# Filter the dataset by regions
south_asia_data <- snse.df |> filter(country %in% south_asia)
southeast_asia_data <- snse.df |> filter(country %in% southeast_asia)
```

**South Asia Stats:**

IMR as a function of PM 2.5 exposure in S. Asia

```{r}
ggplot(south_asia_data, aes(x = pm2.5, y = infant_mortality)) +
  geom_point(color = "orange") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkblue") +
  labs(title = "PM 2.5 Mean Annual Exposure vs Infant Mortality Rate (S Asia)",
       x = "PM2.5 Mean Annual Exposure (µg/m^3)",
       y = "Infant Mortality Rate (per 1000 live births)") +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
model <- lm(south_asia_data$infant_mortality~south_asia_data$pm2.5)
summary(model)
```

```{r}
south_asia_data |>
  model_train(infant_mortality~pm2.5) |>
  conf_interval()
```


```{r}
south_asia_data |>
  feols(infant_mortality~pm2.5 | country) |>
  conf_interval()
```

## Regression equation: (infant mortality)i = 4.79 + 0.77(PM2.5)

IMR as a function of PM 2.5 Exposure and Per Capita Health Exp:

```{r}
ggplot(south_asia_data, aes(x = pm2.5, y = infant_mortality)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = health_exp_pct), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se = FALSE, color="black")
  labs(title = "Infant Mortality vs PM2.5 and Health Expenditure",
       x = "PM2.5 Exposure",
       y = "Infant Mortality Rate",
       color = "Health Exp. (% of Govt Expenditure)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
sasia.model.2 <- lm(south_asia_data$infant_mortality~south_asia_data$pm2.5+south_asia_data$health_exp_pct)
summary(sasia.model.2)
```

```{r}
sasia.model.int <- lm(south_asia_data$infant_mortality~south_asia_data$pm2.5*south_asia_data$health_exp_pct)
summary(sasia.model.int)
```

```{r}
south_asia_data$health_exp_pcap <- as.numeric(south_asia_data$health_exp_pcap)
```

```{r}
sasia.model.int2 <- lm(south_asia_data$infant_mortality~south_asia_data$pm2.5*south_asia_data$fuel_access)
summary(sasia.model.int2)
```


**Stats for Southeast Asia:**

```{r}
ggplot(southeast_asia_data, aes(x = pm2.5, y = infant_mortality)) +
```

```{r}
se.model <- lm(southeast_asia_data$infant_mortality~southeast_asia_data$pm2.5)
summary(se.model)
```

## Regression equation: (infant mortality)i = -10.73 + 1.34(PM2.5)

```{r}
southeast_asia_data$health_exp_pct <- as.numeric(southeast_asia_data$health_exp_pct)
```

```{r}
ggplot(southeast_asia_data, aes(x = pm2.5, y = infant_mortality)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = health_exp_pct), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black")
  labs(title = "Infant Mortality vs PM2.5 and Health Expenditure",
       x = "PM2.5 Exposure",
       y = "Infant Mortality Rate",
       color = "Health Exp. (% of Govt Expenditure)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
se.model.2 <- lm(southeast_asia_data$infant_mortality~southeast_asia_data$pm2.5 + southeast_asia_data$health_exp_pct)
summary(se.model.2)
```

```{r}
mean_south_asia <- mean(south_asia_data$health_exp_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_southeast_asia <- mean(southeast_asia_data$health_exp_pct, na.rm = TRUE)

# Combine mean values into a data frame
means_data <- data.frame(
  Region = c("South Asia", "Southeast Asia"),
  Mean_Health_Exp = c(mean_south_asia, mean_southeast_asia)
)

# Create a bar chart
ggplot(means_data, aes(x = Region, y = Mean_Health_Exp, fill = Region)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Health Expenditure by Region",
    x = "Region",
    y = "Mean Health Expenditure (% of GDP)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
summary_data <- data.frame(
  Region = c("South Asia", "Southeast Asia"),
  Health_Exp_Pct = c(mean(south_asia_data$health_exp_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 
                     mean(southeast_asia_data$health_exp_pct, na.rm = TRUE)),
  PM2_5 = c(mean(south_asia_data$pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE), 
            mean(southeast_asia_data$pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE)),
  Infant_Mortality = c(mean(south_asia_data$infant_mortality, na.rm = TRUE), 
                       mean(southeast_asia_data$infant_mortality, na.rm = TRUE))
)

# Reshape data to long format for ggplot
summary_data_long <- summary_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Region, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

ggplot(summary_data_long, aes(x = Region, y = Value, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Health Expenditure, PM2.5, and Infant Mortality by Region",
    x = "Region",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
